title: Coin Path
statement: Given a string of characters, find the first character that appears only once in the string. If no such character exists, return `null`. The string will only contain lowercase English letters. **Example Use Cases:** * Finding the first unique character in a word or phrase * Identifying the first non-repeating character in a sentence * Determining if a string has any unique characters. **Constraints:** * The input string will have a length between 1 and 1000 characters * The input string will only contain lowercase English letters.
